name: cops
description: Skills for working with pull requests — reviewing, describing, syncing, or otherwise assisting with the PR lifecycle.

PR_MEMORY_PATH.title: PR memory workspace path
PR_MEMORY_PATH.description: Path to the memory Git repository included in this workspace. Supports absolute paths, ~/..., and $HOME/....

PR_MEMORY_LOGIN.title: PR memory GitHub login
PR_MEMORY_LOGIN.description: Your GitHub login. Names your personal tree, memory/users/<login>/. Required for personal memory; COPS never derives it from gh, GitHub MCP, Git, or the machine.
